summary: David Mutabazi, 24, a CPW seasonal employee at Steamboat Lake State Park since May, drowned while swimming ~100 yards from shore after his shift; a witness could not reach him; CPW park rangers and a Routt County deputy recovered his body ~9:45 p.m. the same evening; the Routt County Sheriff's Office investigation concluded the drowning was accidental.
location: Steamboat Lake, Steamboat Lake State Park
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife; Routt County Sheriff's Office
notes: Run 1002 insert; North Forty News article published 2018-07-15 ("Tuesday afternoon at approximately 4:30 p.m." -> 2018-07-10, Tuesday-verified). Second drowning at Steamboat Lake State Park in the last two months per the article; prior to these, park officials had recorded no drownings in the lake's history.
